## setting
**39 run(s)** — rule `visser21-field-setting` — 10.1111/ppa.13468  
*Methods, Puccinia striiformis isolates*

> A TOTAL OF 39 Pst-INFECTED WHEAT LEAF SAMPLES that consisted of a single lesion WERE COLLECTED FROM THE FIELD in South Africa and Kenya... Thirty-nine is exactly the field arm that visser21-isolates-setting had already separated by collection date, so the paper confirms the split run for run. The other arm is explicit too: "Fresh inoculum of Pst isolates was prepared by inoculating SEEDLINGS of the susceptible wheat variety MOROCCO grown in Mikskaar Professional Potting Soil 70", and those samples "were collected from wheat plants INOCULATED with purified South African Pst isolates that were collected between 1996 and 2017". Replaces an automated same-sentence match that had hedged on 'the majority of stripe rust field samples were sent directly for sequencing'.

## location
*2 run(s) carry the archive's own value (submitter-deposited), not a manuscript claim.*

**37 run(s)** — rule `visser21-PRJEB36485-location` — 10.1111/ppa.13468  
*Supplemental Table S2 (ppa13468-sup-0004-tables2.xlsx), header at row 2*

> Pst isolate table, 116 rows: Isolate ID, Country of isolation, Town of isolation, Host when collected, Date collected, Type of data, Data Reference, Additional references, Accession numbers, South African pathotypes. Isolate ID is the ENA sample_title verbatim and all 49 of PRJEB36485's titles are present. Town of isolation is given for 26 of them, all South African: Bethlehem 13, Greytown 4, Bredasdorp 4, and one each of Jozini, Sutherland, Luckhoff, Napier, Riversdal. The 13 Kenyan samples give '-'. Date collected is year only. Wiley returns 403 to every automated route and the article has no PMC record, so this file was downloaded by hand (leon, 2026-10-12). Table S2 disagrees with the Ada21 supplement on two samples, 14/SADL1 and 14/SADL2: Bredasdorp here, Ouplaas there, about 45 km apart in the same Overberg district. Ada21 is the only source with a day-precision date for exactly those samples (2014/08/23 against a bare '2014'), so it is carrying the original collection record while this table rounds to the district town; visser21.py skips the two rather than overwriting the finer value.
